reviews.summary: Fresh broad review approved the exact six-row refund-validation blocked-environment deferral and four-field-only specified-to-deferred transition; canonical calibration bundle ab2b1f40a319fe03533e3128ee3ba6581e1f5959bbe1b4d057a1e0ee79d7d1ec; provider-free runtime failures at :8086 (connection refused), :8087 (no active WooCommerce REST route), and :8889 (HTTP 401), all before fixture creation; the repeated material response-headers-versus-jQuery-DOM synchronization finding after the two-cycle revision cap; lower-layer non-substitution and preservation of committed fix 1c8712f425dab6e604e24158a118c0abd94c1307; absence of browser/provider/lifecycle/cleanup-residue/quarantine claims; and the smallest complete unlock of an externally ready authenticated Core E2E site plus a fresh authorized adaptation iteration proving a discriminating post-reload DOM state with one worker, zero retries, and fresh reviews.

deferral.blocker: The required provider-free browser smoke cannot execute in an approved Core E2E runtime: the configured localhost:8086 endpoint refuses connections, the exact-checkout test site on localhost:8087 has no active WooCommerce REST route, and the exact-checkout development site on localhost:8889 rejects the first REST request with HTTP 401. The final uncommitted adaptation also retained a repeated rendered-DOM synchronization review finding after two revision cycles.
deferral.affected_scope: Only the six specified invalid-refund contracts and their required lower-layer-plus-one-browser-smoke disposition. The committed lower-layer matrix and bounded Core validation correction remain available, but no required-green browser proof, rendered post-rejection state, or closed native support is claimed.
deferral.no_allowlisted_action_reason: The run cannot start, repair, restart, reseed, or reconfigure shared E2E sites or credentials. It also cannot waive a repeated material review finding or exceed the two-cycle revision cap. Static collection, controller tests, and the committed lower-layer regression matrix do not substitute for the required browser boundary.
deferral.unlock_decision: Externally provide a reachable configured Core E2E site with valid WooCommerce REST credentials and authenticated admin access, then authorize a fresh implementation iteration that proves response completion and a discriminating post-reload DOM state before the no-refund assertion. Rerun the provider-free smoke once with one worker and zero retries and obtain fresh implementation reviews before closure.
deferral.quarantine_status: All browser attempts stopped before fixture creation, provider work, or browser mutation. No account, store, order, product, refund, setting, listener, lock, journal, or quarantine was created; the separately owned provider listener remains untouched.
